violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CHICKEN TENDERS AT 83-89F AND CHICKEN NUGGETS AT 110-127F IN THE RIGHT TWO-DOOR STACKED HOTBOX. OBSERVED BEEF SANDWICHES AT 117F AND TURKEY SANDWICHES AT 97-98F IN THE RIGHT TWO-DOOR STACKED HOTBOX.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PROPER HOT HOLDING PROCEDURES WERE DISCUSSED. FOOD ITEMS WERE MOVED TO COOLER TO COOL, OR SERVED WITHIN AN HOUR (FOOD HAD FINISHED REHEATING APPROXIMATELY AN HOUR PRIOR). EHS REVIEWED DOCUMENTED REHEATING TEMPERATURES. PLEASE ENSURE FOOD ITEMS ON SERVICE LINE ARE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CHICKEN TENDERS AT. 128-132F IN LEFT 2-DOOR STACKED HOTBOX; OBSERVED CHICKEN WINGS AT 95-97F AND CHEESE QUESADILLA AT 112-120F IN LEFT SERVICE LINE; OBSERVED CHICKEN WINGS AT 104-118F IN RIGHT SERVICE LINE
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED ALL FOODS TO 165F+ DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS HOT HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE MAINTAINED AT 135F AND STEAM TABLES SHOULD BE KEPT HIGHER TO ENSURE FOODS HOT HOLD PROPERLY.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food is not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: OBSERVED MANY WRAPPED BATCHES OF COOKED GOLDEN BEETS AT 44-46F IN AFTER SCHOOL PROGRAM 2-DOOR UPR COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED OF ALL BEETS DURING INSPECTION. PROPER COOLING METHODS WERE DISCUSSED. PLEASE ENSURE COOLING FOODS ARE NOT WRAPPED TIGHTLY UNTIL THEY ARE AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED MEATBALL SANDWICHES IN RIGHT 2-DOOR STACKED HOT HOLDING CABINET AT 108-119F. PIC HAD DOCUMENTED APPROXIMATELY 20 MINUTES PRIOR THAT MEATBALLS WERE AT 164F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC UNDERSTANDS HOT HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE AT ALL TIMES. PIC BELIEVES TEMPERATURE DROP COULD HAVE BEEN CAUSED BY BREAD USED FOR SANDWICHES BEING COLD WHEN THE SANDWICHES WERE ASSEMBLED. EHS RECOMMENDS NEXT TIME TO REHEAT SANDWICHES IF THE BREAD IS COLD, PRIOR TO PUTTING THEM INTO THE HOT HOLDING CABINET. SANDWICHES WERE TO BE SERVED WITIHN THE FOLLOWING HOUR, SO SANDWICHES WERE SERVED AS ORIGINAL TEMPERATURE OF MEATBALLS DOCUMENTED WAS 164F. DOGWOOD ELEMENTARY SCHOOL (Inspection Date: 03/20/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED MULTIPLE SMALL BATCHES AND BOXES OF CREAM CHEESE AT 47-57F, CONTAINERS OF YOGURT AT 41-55F, AND STRING CHEESES AT 57F IN TWO-DOOR UPR COOLER IN CAFE AREA. OBSERVED SHREDDED LETTUCE AT 46-47F IN MILK CHEST, COMMERCIAL RANCH (FOR REFERENCE TEMPERATURE) OBSERVED AT 48-49F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION IN TWO DOOR UPR COOLER THAT WERE OUT OF TEMPERATURE AND MOVED LETTUCE IN MILK CHEST TO ANOTHER COOLER. ALL OTHER TCS FOODS IN TWO-DOOR UPR WITH ACCEPTABLE TEMPERATURES (WHICH WERE DELIVERED THE DAY OF INSPECTION) WERE MOVED TO ANOTHER COLD HOLDING UNIT. PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD ALWAYS BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW AND THIS UNIT SHOULD NOT BE USED UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

violations.title: Air/Water Thermometers Accuracy, Only Degrees F
violations.observation: The ambient air temperature measuring device located in the following unit is not accurate in degrees F: AFTER SCHOOL PROGRAM TWO-DOOR UPR COOLER (20-50F DURING INSPECTION, BUT ACTUALLY AT 46F) AND TWO-DOOR UPR COOLER IN CAFE SEATING AREA (40-41F, BUT ACTUALLY AT 61F).
violations.corrective_action: Ambient air and water temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to +/-3 degrees F in the intended range of use. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE COOLERS SHOULD BE REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND THAT UNIT THERMOMETERS SHOULD BE REPAIRED, OR NEW UNIT THERMOMETERS SHOULD BE ADDED TO ENSURE STAFF KNOW THAT UNITS ARE WORKING CORRECTLY AND TO PREVENT COLD HOLDING ISSUES AGAIN IN THE FUTURE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED TWO-DOOR COOLER IN CAFE SEATING AREA AT 61F WITH EHS THERMOMETER (UNIT THERMOMETER READ AT 40-41F); OBSERVED AFTERSCHOOL PROGRAM COOLER IN CAFE AREA AT 46F WITH EHS THERMOMETER (UNIT THERMOMETER AT 20-50F); OBSERVED MILK CHEST BY OFFICE AT 47F WITH EHS THERMOMETER (UNIT THERMOMETER AT 42F)
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. WORK ORDERS WERE PLACED FOR COOLERS DURING INSPECTION. THESE COOLERS NEED TO BE REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND SHOULD MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F BEFORE USING FOR TCS FOODS AGAIN. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.
